name: timer
meaning: 12.12 fixed accumulator of g_dt. In state 1 it is the fall timer, clamped to 0x1e000, and the fall speed is timer*2000>>12 clamped to [120,1000] u/s. In state 2 it is the sink timer; at 0x1000 (one second) the ball calls its own Reset.

name: spawnPos
meaning: Home position captured by PostLoadInit after ScnObject_SnapToGround (dword+word copy at 0x4a5621); Reset teleports the ball back to it through vtable +0x1c. 0x80+6 = 0x86, the next field.

name: state
meaning: 0 resting/held (waiting for a move modifier), 1 falling under gravity (magnet sound 0x110 while a magnet touches it, death boxes tested each frame), 2 sinking inside a death box for one second before Reset.

name: flags
meaning: Bit 0 = the last move ended touching a MOVABLE-class object - it is written from ContactInfo+8, which ContactInfo.csv names movableObj (classFlags & 4), not a general contact word. Bit 1 = a magnet is touching this frame (MSG_MAGNET_CONTACT 0x73). Bit 2 = the magnet sound has been started.

name: moveModifier
meaning: The registered move modifier (platform, lift, carpet, train or magnet). Set by msg 0x18 only when free, cleared by 0x19 only for the matching sender. While set the ball moves with slide flags 7 instead of 2, skips the death-box test, and CannonBall2_Move sends it MSG_MODIFY_MOVE 0x1a.
